sanskrit_verse:
धर्मशास्त्रार्थकुशलाः कुलीनाः सत्यवादिनः
समाः शत्रौ च मित्रे च नृपतेः स्युः सभासदः
transliteration: dharmaśāstrārthakuśalāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ samāḥ śatrau ca mitre ca nṛpateḥ syuḥ sabhāsadaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Those well-versed in the meaning of Dharma Śāstra, of noble conduct, truthful speakers, impartial towards enemies and allies alike—these alone shall be the advisors in the court of the sovereign.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derived from scriptural mastery and personal integrity
Causation through alignment with Sanātana Dharma
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in consciousness maturity
Consciousness alignment as prerequisite for judicial participation
executable_legal_axioms: IF advisor lacks dharmaśāstra competence THEN disqualify from judicial counsel
IF advisor shows partiality to friend or foe THEN remove from sabhā seating
IF advisor does not uphold satya-vāda THEN exclude from decision-making process
IF advisor is not kulīna by svabhāva THEN deemed unfit for advising the sovereign
supreme_court_application: In the Supreme Court of the Sovereign, only those who demonstrate mastery of Dharma Śāstra, unwavering truth-speaking, absence of bias, and innate nobility of character shall be seated as judicial advisors. Partiality or lack of scriptural grounding invalidates one's presence in the highest judicial body.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through svabhāva and śāstric knowledge, not coercion. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that only those whose consciousness aligns with Nyāya are positioned in judgment. Responsibility flows from capacity; misalignment is corrected through removal, not punishment. Truth prevails when advisors embody satya as their nature.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reintegration protocol for disqualified advisors through śāstra study and svadharma rectification
Completion process for partial individuals to restore neutrality via pratyāhāra
Capacity restoration through tapas and śravaṇa until eligibility is regained
Integrity reintegration through public acknowledgment and realignment under a qualified guru
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: advisors in the court of the sovereign must arise from dharmaśāstra mastery, nobility, truth, and equanimity. Dharma is thus restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone is the supreme adjudicator.
